title: Solving Shifted Systems for Quasiseparable Matrices
summary: In this paper we develop fast numerical algorithms for solving shifted linear systems with semidefinite quasiseparable matrices. A combination of Givens and hyperbolic plane rotations is used to update the Cholesky-type factorization of the input quasiseparable matrix by determining a factorization of its shifted version of the form $LDL^T$, where $L$ is lower triangular and $D$ is a signature matrix.
